title: Privacy-Utility Tradeoffs with Quantum Local Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2602.10510v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When sensitive information is encoded in data, it is important to ensure the privacy of information when attempting to learn useful information from the data. There is a natural tradeoff whereby increasing privacy requirements may decrease the utility of a learning protocol. In the quantum setting of differential privacy, such tradeoffs between privacy and utility have so far remained largely unexplored. In this work, we study optimal privacy-utility tradeoffs for both generic and application-specific utility metrics when privacy is quantified by $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-quantum local differential privacy. In the generic setting, we focus on optimizing fidelity and trace distance between the original state and the privatized state. translated_title: 量子局部差分隐私中的隐私-效用权衡
translated_abstract: 当敏感信息被编码在数据中时，在尝试从数据中学习有用信息的同时确保信息的隐私性至关重要。这里存在一个自然的权衡：提高隐私要求可能会降低学习协议的效用。在差分隐私的量子设定中，这种隐私与效用之间的权衡迄今为止在很大程度上尚未被探索。在本工作中，我们研究了当隐私由$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-量子局部差分隐私量化时，针对通用效用度量和特定应用效用度量的最优隐私-效用权衡。在通用设定中，我们专注于优化原始态与私有化态之间的保真度和迹距离。我们证明了去极化机制在给定的隐私要求下能够实现最优效用。随后，我们研究了学习可观测量期望值这一具体应用（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-量子局部差分隐私框架下的最优隐私-效用权衡，证明了去极化机制在保真度和迹距离等通用效用度量下达到理论最优。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies optimal privacy-utility tradeoffs under $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-quantum local differential privacy, proving that the depolarizing mechanism achieves optimal utility for generic metrics such as fidelity and trace distance.
